# Security Policy

## Supported service

The currently deployed Hongje Middle School Integrated System is supported. Security reports must not contain student, staff, login, session, or API-key data.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not post suspected vulnerabilities in a public GitHub issue. Report them privately to the school system administrator through the school-approved internal contact channel. Include:

- a concise description and affected URL or feature;
- safe, reproducible steps that do not access other users' data;
- expected and actual behavior; and
- any suggested mitigation.

## Testing rules

- Do not attempt password guessing, account enumeration, denial-of-service testing, or bulk automated scanning against the live service.
- Do not access, download, modify, or disclose personal information.
- Do not test third-party systems (Google, NEIS, weather providers) through this service.
- Stop testing immediately if personal data or an active session is exposed.

## Response process

The administrator will acknowledge a valid report, assess impact, prepare a fix, and coordinate disclosure after remediation. Emergency issues may result in temporary service suspension.
